description.en: The Solarized Light palette: warm cream base tones and precise, muted colors, made for long reading, with a blue accent by default. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
The button, links and focused fields. Solarized's accents are yellow #b58900, orange #cb4b16, red #dc322f, magenta #d33682, violet #6c71c4, blue #268bd2, cyan #2aa198 and green #859900.
